beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Jesus had brought his disciples a long way north, to a quiet place far from the crowds, up under a great cliff of pale rock. And there he asked them a question he had never asked so plainly before.

timing.text: Jesus had brought his disciples a long way north, to a quiet place far from the crowds, up under a great cliff of pale rock.

beats.speaker: jesus
beats.text: Whom do men say that I the Son of man am?

timing.text: Whom do men say that I the Son of man am?

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: It was an easy question at first. What are people saying? And they had plenty of answers ready.

timing.text: It was an easy question at first.
What are people saying?

beats.speaker: scripture
beats.text: Some say that thou art John the Baptist: some, Elias; and others, Jeremias, or one of the prophets.

timing.text: Some say that thou art John the Baptist: some, Elias; and others, Jeremias, or one of the prophets.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Some say Elijah come back. Others, Jeremiah, or one of the old prophets. All respectful. All safe. All second-hand — what other people thought.

timing.text: Some say Elijah come back.

beats.speaker: jesus
beats.text: But whom say ye that I am?

timing.text: But whom say ye that I am?

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: And there it was. Not what have you heard. Not what is the crowd saying. But you — who do you say that I am? The question stopped them cold. This one you cannot borrow from anybody else.

timing.text: And there it was.

And Simon Peter answered him.

beats.speaker: scripture
beats.text: Thou art the Christ, the Son of the living God.

timing.text: Thou art the Christ, the Son of the living God.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Not a prophet. Not a teacher. Peter said out loud the thing the others had only half-dared to hope.

timing.text: Not a prophet.
Not a teacher.

beats.speaker: jesus
beats.text: Blessed art thou, Simon Barjona: for flesh and blood hath not revealed it unto thee, but my Father which is in heaven.

timing.text: Blessed art thou, Simon Barjona: for flesh and blood hath not revealed it unto thee, but my Father which is in heaven.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: You did not work this out on your own, Jesus told him. This kind of knowing does not come from clever thinking. It is given, quietly, from God, to a heart ready to receive it.

timing.text: You did not work this out on your own, Jesus told him.

beats.speaker: jesus
beats.text: And I say also unto thee, That thou art Peter, and upon this rock I will build my church; and the gates of hell shall not prevail against it.

timing.text: And I say also unto thee, That thou art Peter, and upon this rock I will build my church; and the gates of hell shall not prevail against it.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: On this — on knowing who he really is — he would build something that hell itself could never tear down. Everything else in the gospel is built on top of this one answer.

card.text: The crowds had their opinions; Peter had an answer he would stake his life on. Jesus is still asking the one question that no one can answer for you. Who do YOU say that he is?
